concept: Full-body concept art of Siren Head, a giant emaciated humanoid creature for a horror video game, seen strictly from the front: it faces the camera straight on, in a symmetrical standing pose. Its body is extremely tall and skinny, with dry, cracked, greyish-brown skin stretched over visible ribs. Instead of a head, a long thin neck rises from its shoulders and ends in two large grey metal air raid siren loudspeakers mounted side by side, their round openings facing the camera. Rig-ready pose: its very long, thin arms hang slightly away from its body with a clear gap between each arm and the torso, its long bony fingers spread, and its two long legs stand apart with a visible gap between them. One single creature, centered, the whole body visible from the sirens to the feet. Plain uniform light grey studio background, no floor, no ground, no pole, no pedestal, no cast shadow, soft even studio lighting.
desc_courte: Siren Head, giant emaciated humanoid with dry cracked greyish-brown skin, extremely long thin arms and legs, long thin neck ending in two grey metal air raid siren loudspeakers instead of a head
garde: Keep the exact same creature: identical anatomy and proportions, the same dry cracked greyish-brown skin, the same long thin neck with the two grey metal siren loudspeakers, the same colours and materials. Same plain uniform light grey studio background, same soft even studio lighting, same scale, the whole body visible, no floor, no cast shadow.
